rules.year_filter: local departure year in the flight tz; unknown tz falls back to UTC; year null = all time
rules.per_year: flights per local departure year over all time (ignores year), ascending, years with flights only
rules.per_month: 12 counts, January first, local departure time in the flight tz
rules.per_weekday: 7 counts, Monday first, local departure time in the flight tz
rules.unknown_country_flights: flights with at least one unknown country; domestic + international + unknown = flights
rules.averages: rounded half up to integer, 0 when nothing to average
rules.flight_minutes: sum of block_minutes, null counts as 0
rules.air_minutes: sum of air_minutes, null counts as 0
rules.taxi_minutes: sum of max(0, block_minutes - air_minutes) over flights with both
rules.shortest_longest: ties go to the earliest departed_at (input order on equal instants); by time ignores flights without block_minutes; null when none
rules.airport_visits: flights sorted by departed_at; destination one visit; origin one visit unless the previous flight landed there (departed_at + 60 * block_minutes, null block counts 0) under 28800 s before this departure; sorted visits desc then icao asc
rules.airline_key: airline as given; null or empty skipped
rules.tally_by_flights_order: flights desc, distance_km desc, key asc
rules.tally_by_distance_order: distance_km desc, flights desc, key asc
rules.countries: each known country once per flight; sorted flights desc then iso2 asc
rules.regions: all nine in declaration order; total = reference countries in the region; visited = distinct visited countries in the region (countries absent from the reference count nowhere)
